product.title: Guided Sunset Bat Kayak Tour in Austin

description.text: Kayak Lady Bird Lake at sunset with a guide and watch Austin's famous bat colony leave Congress Avenue Bridge. Gear is included on this approximately two-hour outing suited to beginners and visitors seeking a water-level skyline view. Stops include Lady Bird Lake Launch, Downtown Skyline, Congress Avenue Bridge, Bat Viewing. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Austin skyline views, lake corridors, and Hill Country highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Austin who want a guided Capital City experience without coordinating meeting points, trailheads, or photo locations on their own.
